name: Joker X Love

features.name: Multiplier machine
features.description: A three-reel machine reveals a 5x–999x multiplier.

review:
A romantic take on the 3x3 fruit classic, with five lines. Three Joker X Love symbols on the first three reels open the bonus.

A three-reel machine spins up a multiplier between 5x and 999x, applied to your bet. You can also buy the bonus for 80x. Very high volatility and a 1,059x cap, 96.23% RTP. It shares maths with Wild Cash, so bought bonuses often return less than they cost – fun in demo, though.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Very high volatility – long dry spells are normal
Bonus buy is costly and banned in some markets (e.g. Great Britain)
